texts.li: {B_nameDef} says {A_nameDef} has walked the rows behind {B_objective} since {A_pronoun} was small enough to be lost in the corn, pulling the wrong weeds with great confidence. Now that {A_nameDef} has come of age, {B_nameDef} would like {A_objective} to learn which ones are the right ones.

"Ask {A_objective} which field wants resting and {A_pronoun}'ll tell you," {B_nameDef} told the council. {A_nameDef} came of age this week, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} in the fields with {B_objective} before the next sowing.
[lowtech] {B_nameDef} has kept the seed baskets for years and means to hand the knack on to someone. {A_nameDef}, just come of age, is the one {B_pronoun} has in mind.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in the fields
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spent the first morning on {A_possessive} knees in the soil while {B_nameDef} talked about roots, and came in at noon muddy to the elbows and asking about manure.

li.label: The workshop needs hands more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} goes to the workbench instead of the fields. {B_nameDef} said nothing, and went out to the rows alone the next morning as usual.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} thought it over for a day and a night, and took nobody's advice in the end, which {B_nameDef} said was the first sign of a grower.

texts.li: Every time {B_nameDef} turned round in the kitchen these last years, {A_nameDef} was there, tasting what {A_pronoun} shouldn't. {A_nameDef} has come of age now, and {B_nameDef} says {A_pronoun} may as well taste it for a reason.
"A colony eats three times a day whether anyone thanks the cook or not," {B_nameDef} told the council. "I'd like someone to thank me by learning it." {B_pronoun} means {A_nameDef}, just come of age.

{B_nameDef} has kept a list in {B_possessive} head of what {A_nameDef} will and won't eat since {A_nameDef} was small. Now {A_nameDef} is grown, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the stove, learning why.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in the kitchen
li.outcome: {A_nameDef}'s first lesson was onions, a great many of them, and {A_pronoun} cried through most of it and was very proud of the soup.

li.label: The building crew needs hands more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is put on the building crew, and will learn the work there instead of at the stove.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has been asked what {A_pronoun} wants, and is taking the question very seriously.

texts.li: {B_nameDef} has taken to leaving the gate to the pens open whenever {A_nameDef} is about, and pretending not to notice who closes it. {A_nameDef} has come of age, and {B_nameDef} thinks {A_pronoun} should stop closing gates and start learning what is behind them.

The animals follow {A_nameDef} about the yard, {B_nameDef} told the council, and that can't be taught. The rest can. {A_nameDef} came of age this week, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the pens.

[lowtech] {B_nameDef} says the beasts have known {A_nameDef}'s step since {A_pronoun} was a child, and calm at it. Now that {A_nameDef} is grown, {B_nameDef} would teach {A_objective} the rest of the handler's trade.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} with the animals
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spent the first day learning to stand still in a pen until the animals forgot {A_pronoun} was there. {B_nameDef} says that is most of it.

li.label: The fields first
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} goes to the fields, and the animals will have to do without {A_objective}. They still follow {A_objective} to the fence every morning.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went out to the pens to think it over, which some took as an answer already.

texts.li: Half the walls in this colony have {A_nameDef}'s handprints in the mortar, {B_nameDef} says, from the years {A_pronoun} was too small to be any help and helped anyway. {A_nameDef} has come of age, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} on the building crew properly.
"Someone has to know how the roof stays up when I'm gone," {B_nameDef} told the council, "and {A_nameDef} already asks." {A_nameDef} came of age this week.
[lowtech] {B_nameDef} raised most of the colony's walls with {B_possessive} own hands, and would teach {A_nameDef}, just come of age, how a wall is laid so it still stands in fifty winters.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in building
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} laid {A_possessive} first course of the wall crooked, took it down without being told, and laid it again. {B_nameDef} looked pleased about the second part.

li.label: The kitchen needs hands more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is put in the kitchen instead, and will learn to cook rather than to build.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The choice is left to {A_nameDef}, who is taking the question seriously.
